title: Close Increment 01-zmf
description:
## Objective
The final task of the increment. After this, /devmeta:go STOPS.

## Implementation
1. Verify every exit criterion in `_overview.md` is checked off with evidence.
2. Set the increment status to COMPLETE in `_overview.md`.
3. Update `.devmeta/current-increment.md`: increment 01-zmf complete, no active increment.
4. Write the closing entry in `.devmeta/project-history.md`.
5. Open and merge the PR from the base branch, tag the increment.
6. Do NOT bootstrap a next increment. Do NOT ask which one is next. STOP.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build && npm run slides && npm run diagrams && npm run layout`
acceptance_criteria: increment marked COMPLETE; every exit criterion evidenced; base branch merged
